problem: बचन सुनाए = he called out / spoke some words; 'अपनी बात सुनायी' suggests Hanumān told his own account, which Vibhīṣaṇa asks for only in the next half-line. Also 'सारा' (वृत्तान्त) is not in the verse (निज कथा).
fix: ब्राह्मणका रूप धरकर हनुमान्‌जीने उनसे कुछ कहा। सुनते ही विभीषण उठकर वहाँ आये। उन्होंने प्रणाम किया, कुशल पूछी और कहा — हे विप्र! अपना वृत्तान्त समझाकर कहिये।

problem: हरि is 'the Lord' or 'Śrī Hari' by the style sheet, not bare 'Hari'.
fix: Are you one of the servants of Śrī Hari? A great love is rising in my heart. Or else, are you Śrī Rāma himself, who loves the humble, come to make me blessed?

problem: हरिकृपा: 'the grace of Hari' should be 'Śrī Hari' (style sheet §6).
fix: My body is tāmasic, of the nature of darkness; I have no spiritual practice, and my mind has no love for the lotus feet of the Lord. Yet now, Hanumān, I have taken heart, for without the grace of Śrī Hari one does not meet saints.

problem: भेद (the fourth of the four means) as bare 'division' is unclear to most readers; it means sowing discord.
fix: In many ways the wicked one tried to win Sītā over, using conciliation, gifts, intimidation and sowing discord. Rāvaṇa said: Listen, fair-faced and clever one: Mandodarī and all my other queens

problem: Most readers will not know that चन्द्रहास is Rāvaṇa's sword (the sword just drawn in 9.do9); without it the address is unclear. A short gloss once is allowed (style §2).
fix: हे चन्द्रहास (रावणकी तलवार)! श्रीरघुनाथजीके विरहकी आगसे उपजे मेरे सन्तापको हर लो। तुम्हारी धार शीतल, तीखी और श्रेष्ठ है। सीताजीने कहा — मेरे दुःखका बोझ उतार दो।

problem: As in Hindi: 'Candrahāsa' needs a short gloss (Rāvaṇa's sword) to be understood.
fix: Candrahāsa (Rāvaṇa's sword), take away my anguish, born of the fire of separation from Śrī Rāma. Your edge is cool, keen and fine. Sītā said: Take away the weight of my sorrow.

problem: सीता कर मन सोच = Sītā was anxious/grieved at heart; 'सोचने लगीं' (began to think) loses the anxiety (the English 'thought anxiously' keeps it).
fix: तब वे सब इधर-उधर चली गयीं। सीताजी मनमें चिन्ता करने लगीं — महीना बीतनेपर यह नीच राक्षस मुझे मार डालेगा।

problem: 'hard sword' reads as physical hardness; कठिन कृपाना is a harsh, cruel sword.
fix: Sītā, you have insulted me. I will cut off your head with this cruel sword. Otherwise, do as I say at once, fair one, or you will lose your life.

problem: 'told them her dream: Serve Sītā…' makes 'Serve Sītā' read as the content of the dream; the dream itself follows in the next verse. The Hindi has it right (सुनाकर कहा —).
fix: One demoness, named Trijaṭā, loved Śrī Rāma's feet and was wise in discernment. She called them all together, told them her dream and said: Serve Sītā and so do yourselves good.

problem: A colon is not Hindi punctuation in our style (। ! — ; ,).
fix: मैं यह सपना पुकारकर कहती हूँ कि चार दिन बीतते ही यह सच होगा। उसकी बात सुनकर वे सब डर गयीं और जनकनन्दिनीके चरणोंमें गिर पड़ीं।

problem: 'सीताजी … उठीं और उसे हाथमें थाम लिया' mixes a nominative subject with a ने-construction verb (थाम लिया needs सीताजीने).
fix: तब हनुमान्‌जीने हृदयमें विचार करके अँगूठी नीचे डाल दी। मानो अशोकने अंगारा दे दिया हो; सीताजीने हर्षसे उठकर उसे हाथमें थाम लिया।

problem: Agree 'having consoled' does not fit this line, but the consoling sense is used elsewhere (कहि कथा सुहाई मातु बुझाई); add 'explaining', do not drop 'consoling'.
fix: बुझाई: समझाकर / समझा-बुझाकर, ढाढ़स देकर | explaining, making clear / having consoled (root बुझाना)

problem: Agree the sense here is याम (watch of the night), but जामा = 'sprouted' (जमना) in 4 other verses (अंकुर जामा, कलपतरु जामा, तृन नहिं जामा, तरु … जामा); add the sense, do not replace.
fix: जामा: उग आया / पहर (रातका, याम) | sprouted / watch of the night (root जमना / याम)

problem: Agree मानु here is the imperative 'accept', but the noun sense (मान, pride) is used in 'निज सरूप रति मानु बिमोचनि'; keep both.
fix: मानु: घमंड / मान ले | pride / accept, obey (imperative) (root मान / मानना)

problem: Agree 'in the dream' is the sense here, but 'सपने में भी' (even in a dream) is right in 'नहिं सपनें' verses elsewhere; keep both.
fix: सपनें: सपनेमें / सपनेमें भी | in a dream / even in a dream (root सपना)

problem: Agree 'bad, hideous' is missing, but 'धीमा / मूर्ख' is used elsewhere (सीतल मंद सुरभि, मंद महीपन्ह); add, do not replace.
fix: मंद: धीमा / मूर्ख / बुरा, भद्दा | slow, gentle / dull / vile, hideous (विशेषण)

problem: Agree 'edge of a blade' is missing; keep 'stream / held' (सुरसरि धारा, पगु धारा) as well.
fix: धारा: धारा / धारण किया / धार (तलवारकी) | stream / held / edge (of a blade)

problem: Agree the noun 'adornment' is missing, but 'बनाया' is right in many verses (बिरंचि बनावा, पाक बनावा); keep both.
fix: बनावा: बनाया / बनाव, सजावट | made / adornment, finery (root बनाना / बनाव)

problem: Agree 'in every way' is missing, but agentive 'सब ने' is right in 'सबहीं कहा' etc.; keep both.
fix: सबहीं: सब ने / सभी (प्रकारसे) | all (agent) / all, every (way) (root सब)

problem: Agree 'having fixed (the eyes)' is missing, but 'देने से' fits 'जल अंजलि दिएँ'; keep both.
fix: दिएँ: देने से / लगाये हुए, टिकाये हुए | by giving / having fixed (the eyes on) (root देना)

problem: Not flagged by the writer: in 'जीभ बिचारी' बिचारी is बेचारी (poor, wretched), not 'विचारकर'; the sense is missing from the entry.
fix: बिचारी: विचारकर / बेचारी | having considered / poor, wretched (root विचारना / बेचारा)

problem: Not flagged: भेद in 'साम दान भय भेद' is the political means of sowing discord; that sense is missing.
fix: भेद: अंतर / रहस्य / फूट डालना (नीतिका एक उपाय) | difference / secret / sowing discord (one of the four means of policy)

problem: Not flagged: in 'करिहउँ पहिचानी' पहिचानी is a noun (acquaintance, introduction), not 'पहचानकर' (which is right in 13.cau1).
fix: पहिचानी: पहचानकर / पहचान, परिचय | recognising / acquaintance (root पहचानना / पहचान)

problem: Not flagged: in 'करि कर' (elephant's trunk) कर means trunk; the sense is missing from the many-sense entry.
fix: कर: हाथ / सूँड़ / किरण / का (संबंध) / करना | hand / trunk (of an elephant) / ray / of / do (अनेकार्थी)

problem: Not flagged: in 'किएँ बनावा' किएँ is 'having done / with (adornment) put on', not 'by doing'.
fix: किएँ: करनेसे / किये हुए | by doing / having done (root करना)

problem: Not flagged: डारि here is simply 'dropping, letting fall' (the ring); the entry has only 'throwing off'.
fix: डारि: डालकर, गिराकर / उतार फेंककर | dropping, letting fall / throwing off (पूर्वकालिक क्रिया, root डालना)
